eyebrow: The Boring Bogey Blueprint · The Marshes
title: Marchwood
sub: The Marshes · 9 holes, all par 3 · Par 27 · 1,252 yds · walking
thesis: All par 3s, 91 to 186 yards. This is the lab: every swing is a tee shot, so it is the cleanest place to prove smooth means full and committed, not light. The two pars you made here (#3 and #7) both came from committed swings; the short-rights came from decelerating. Aim the dry side, carry what needs carrying, and let the short game do the rest.

tempo.label: One cue, every club
tempo.note: Full and committed, never light. If smooth won't carry, club up. "More" is the miss.

steps.v: 5-hybrid, smooth · carry to center, aim right of the left bunker
Long-center is safe. Short is the front bunker, so take enough club.
8i, smooth · center, nothing to fear here
Two putts, walk off with a par look.
7i · aim a cup LEFT and thread the chute
You parred this one. Trees squeeze both sides, so commit to center-left, no steering.
9i · aim center-left, away from the big RIGHT bunker
Shortest hole out here. Two putts.
6i · center, enough club to carry the front bunker
Long-center is fine. Never leave it short into the sand.
5-hybrid · carry the creek (~100), aim center-left away from the RIGHT bunker
Second-hardest hole. Take the club that carries the creek without thinking, and commit.
6i · center. Trees only on the LEFT, so favour center-right
First green you hit in reg all day. Two putts.
4H to FRONT-RIGHT, or lay up · two bunkers guard the LEFT
Longest and hardest. Front-right is safe; a lay-up and a chip is a perfectly good bogey.
5i or 5H · center, NOT long. Bunker left-front, more sand long-right
This is the "a little more" hole. Take the honest number and swing smooth, not hard.

keys: Smooth is full and committed, not light. Both pars here came from committed swings; every short-right came from decelerating. This is the course to groove it.
"More" is the miss. #9 is where a little extra cost you a ball. If smooth won't carry, club up, never swing harder.
Thick-lie chips get scalded. On grabby rough or wet turf, open the face slightly, ball back, and accelerate down and through. It is a lie problem, not a swing one.
Putts: die it at the hole. Lines are good, speed is the miss. Short putts lean right → aim the LEFT EDGE.
footer: 9 holes, all par 3 · Par 27 · target 33 · "last:" from Aug 6 (37; #6 was estimated after a work call).
